name: Glassbone
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 1, cleric 2, inquisitor 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, spiritualist 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a small bone made of glass forth 5 gp)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You make the creature’s bones fragile. The target takes 5 additional bludgeoning damage from physical attacks.

Additionally, the target takes 1 additional damage per damage dice of spells that deal damage via bones, like boneshaker. If the target does not have bones or an exoskeleton, this spell is ineffective.
